packageRules.description: coturn/coturn publishes every release as a bare `4.17.2` next to a pile of variants (`4.17.2-r0`, `4.17.2-alpine`, `4.17.2-alpine3.24`, `4.17.2-r0-alpine-s390x`) and floating `4`/`4.17` tags. `coturn_version` has to stay a bare three-part version, because `coturn_container_image_tag` appends `-alpine` to it and `4.17.2-alpine-alpine` is not an image. Pinning the versioning to exactly that shape rules the variants out structurally instead of relying on which of them a looser scheme happens to consider unstable, and naming major/minor/patch keeps the update type that drives patch automerging unambiguous.
